voice.summary: Grainhouse writes like a small studio that is confident enough to let a big word do the talking. Copy is brief, a bit wry and always points to the work.
dos: Keep copy to a line wherever possible
Point to the work, not to the studio's virtues
Use warm, human verbs: make, grow, keep
donts: Do not list services in jargon
Do not use 'award-winning' as a lead

taglines: Make it plain, make it big
A studio heard across the room
boilerplate: Grainhouse is an independent design studio that makes identities, websites and editorial work for small, ambitious companies.

microcopy.success: Message sent. We reply within two working days.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Email us directly instead.
microcopy.empty: No work to show in this category yet.

logo.note: A sprout from grain is the pun the name already makes, set under a huge uppercase wordmark.
